title: Shemayah, brother of Achiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Taanit 18b describes two brothers, Shemayah and Achiya. Rashi says they were pious men without identifying them. The Arukh, under Harag, identifies them as the martyrs of Lod mentioned in Pesachim 50a

notes.text: Rashi leaves the brothers unidentified; the identification as Lod’s martyrs is attributed to the Arukh.

The Arukh directly associates Shemayah and his brother with the martyrs of Lod. Taanit also relates a separate exchange involving Lulianus and Pappus. Pesachim and Bava Batra refer to the martyrs collectively.
